about_the_game:
Aim. Flick. Sink the shot.
Step into the arena of precision and finesse with Cup Shot Master—a polished physics-based arcade puzzle where every throw counts. Use your finger—or mouse—to flick a ball, guide it past obstacles, and land it in cups. Over 100 challenging levels await, each with cleverly placed barriers, tricky angles, and satisfying rewards.

Features

  • 100+ handcrafted levels full of varied layouts and evolving difficulty

  • Physics-based gameplay that rewards skill, aim, and touch control

  • Intuitive flick & drag mechanics—easy to learn, challenging to master

  • Clean, vibrant art style with smooth animations and clear visuals

  • No timers, no pressure—play at your own pace

  • Progressive design: early levels teach mechanics; later levels test precision

  • Lean singleplayer experience perfect for short sessions or deep play

About This Game

In Cup Shot Master, your objective is deceptively simple: flick the ball just right so it drops into one or more cups. But each level is a small puzzle in itself, with obstacles, bounce surfaces, and spatial tricks designed to test your perception and dexterity.

You control the shot by dragging and letting go—your angle and speed determine how the ball flies, bounces, and lands. Some levels require direct shots, while others invite ricochets. As the layouts grow more intricate, so does your need to visualize paths, predict bounces, and manage limited space.

There’s no clock, no rush—every level is yours to explore and solve. Replay any level to refine your shot, discover more elegant trajectories, or simply revel in that satisfying cup drop. The tactile nature of the controls makes it ideal for touch screens and mouse alike—whether on desktop or mobile versions.

With clear visuals, crisp feedback, and no unnecessary distractions, Cup Shot Master keeps your focus on the throw—and the gratifying “swish” when the ball lands home. Sessions can be short and relaxing or longer and more engaged, depending on how deep you want to go.

If you enjoy skill-based puzzles, precision challenges, or physics-driven arcade gameplay, Cup Shot Master blends them into a compelling, addictive experience.

short_description: Test your timing and aim in Cup Shot Master! Tap to launch the ball into moving cups as they shift and slide with each level. Simple to play, hard to master — a clean and addictive arcade challenge that keeps you coming back for just one more shot.
